display_title: I Am Reporting a Fraudulent Partnership
description:
"Windy Sky" is a number 1 MMORPG game in Korea, the story of this work follows a player of this virtual reality game who gets involved in a hidden mission and ends up forming a bond with another player. It ends up that the two characters discover that the mission they completed together was actually a wedding ceremony, and that they became the game's first couple.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/fraud_), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/sagigyeolyeon), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/1434019206), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=11282112), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000063979)
